## Release Notes

Life in Loops got a bigger tune-up.

This update brings more tools for making loops your own: clip speed controls, timeline volume editing, local audio imports, audio extraction from clips, and a smoother post editing flow.

DMs got livelier too, with emoji reactions, lightweight markdown, better inbox previews, and sturdier message delivery. Profiles got banner uploads, verified account chips, cleaner text links, and better loading states.

We also added clip trash with 30-day recovery, sharper Explore and Popular filters, better search sorting, improved notifications, smoother feed playback, stronger upload/retry handling, and fixes across comments, invites, collabs, account recovery, and video metadata.

Short version: more creative control, better conversations, smoother feeds, fewer weird edges. Welcome Home.

## English (U.S.) - What to Test

Please focus on the new creator tools and everyday app flow:

- Edit a video with clip speed controls, clip volume, local audio import, and audio extraction.
- Try posting after changing metadata, tags, cover frame, collaborators, or engagement settings.
- Use DMs with emoji reactions, markdown, inbox previews, and message retry/recovery.
- Browse Home, Explore, Popular, search results, profiles, notifications, and comments.
- Try clip library sorting, deleting clips, and restoring from trash.
- Check account flows: sign in, account recovery, profile edits, NIP-05 settings, and returning to the app after closing it.

Please report anything that feels stuck, confusing, out of sync, loses edits, breaks playback, or shows stale counts/bad navigation.

What's new in 1.0.13

Fresh
- Explore got more useful: Popular now has time-period filters, a source toggle, and better surfacing for fresh divine videos.
- Home's For You feed now routes through recommendations, so it should feel less random and more alive.
- Mentions resolve and publish across more surfaces. Profiles, lists, captions, and comments do a better job turning people and links into something tappable.
- The video editor gets a cleaner metadata screen, better clips-library sorting, and audio extraction from your own clips.
- Profile polish keeps moving: banner uploads, staged avatar uploads, verified-account chips, and clearer report flows.
- DMs got a redesigned inbox and conversation screen, plus more reliable outgoing recovery when sends only partially succeed.
- Reports now split child-safety concerns into clearer categories, and bug reports can include image attachments.
- 17 non-English locales are filled out, not just half-there.

Sharper
- The feed is now backed by the native video-player path, with smoother first-frame handling and fewer stale overlays.
- Pause is easier to read, with an always-on pause icon and a toggles pill when playback is paused.
- Audio between editor clips is tighter, and remote audio previews cache better on iOS.
- Notifications route more consistently: replies, unread state, badges, and WebSocket/REST dedupe all got cleaned up.
- Profile and feed performance got another pass: smaller thumbnail decodes, cached blurhash work, fewer polling timers, and less rebuild churn.
- Cache sync is now account-scoped, so switching identities should leave less stale state behind.

Squashed
- Adult-content settings now apply more consistently across playback and profile feeds.
- Unknown moderation labels stop leaking into profile feeds.
- Invite redemption retries transient failures instead of giving up too early.
- Back buttons have a safer fallback when the navigation stack is empty.
- Profile edits preserve arbitrary Kind 0 fields and verified NIP-05 data more reliably.
- Likes, reposts, loops, and interaction counts reset and hydrate more correctly as videos are reused or edited.
- Search, notifications, NIP-05 settings, profile loading, and avatar upload paths got targeted failure handling.
- Android no longer leaves the loading overlay stuck when the first-frame callback stalls.

Quietly looking out for you
- Nostr side effects wait for session readiness before firing.
- Publish failures now distinguish "no relays" from broader publish errors.
- Email addresses are redacted from auth-flow logs.
- CI and build cleanup tightened around iOS, Android, Cloudflare deploy metadata, and old FFmpeg residue.

Loop on.

What's new in 1.0.12

Fresh
- Comments are back. Reply to loops, get pinged when someone replies to
  yours, tap the notification and land right where the conversation is.
- The audio picker now searches, remembers your saved sounds, and lets
  you reuse anyone's track in your own loop. Two new bundled jams in
  the mix: Wednesday My Dudes and State Highway.
- Your divine.video handle finally shows up the way you'd expect: @you,
  no domain dragging behind it.
- Deep-link straight into any Explore tab -- /explore/tab/<name> -- for
  when you want to share exactly what you're seeing.
- Filipino joins the language list. Mabuhay.
- Recording keeps your screen awake so the timer doesn't bail on you
  mid-take.
- DMs queue up locally now -- type, send, walk into a tunnel, message
  still goes out.

Sharper
- Bigger tap targets across the bottom nav and video gestures. Less
  fighting your thumbs.
- Home and fullscreen overlays got a polish pass; the Report sheet now
  actually tells you what each option means.
- Pull-to-refresh on the home feed works again. The New tab refreshes
  fresh, and Popular Now sorts the way it says on the tin.
- View counts and loops on the New feed and your profile match
  Funnelcake -- the numbers you see are the numbers we count.
- Looping uses native Apple playback now, so the seam at the end is
  basically invisible.
- "Divine-hosted only" filter starts on by default. Less slop reaching
  your eyeballs out of the gate.

Squashed
- Notifications: "liked your comment" and "replied to your comment"
  taps go to the right place; the Follow Back button stops disappearing
  on you; mark-all-read rolls back if the server has a bad moment.
- Mentions in comments resolve faster -- no more spinner-on-a-name.
- Edited videos now count likes across every version. Your reactions
  add up the way they should.
- Verified NIP-05 handles survive a profile edit. Collaborator-tagged
  videos stop crashing your own profile feed.
- Black video preview? Gone. Fullscreen engagement stats? Back.
- Square videos sit where they belong, under the fullscreen header.
- Nostr links in messages render as readable links instead of alphabet
  soup.
- Settings deletion confirmation accepts lowercase. We were being
  dramatic.
- Invite codes show the dash hint after the 4th character -- no more
  guessing.
- Videos that won't download evict their bad cache and retry once you
  bounce Settings.

Quietly looking out for you
- iOS hardens the in-app Nostr bridge with per-frame origin checks.
- Logs no longer keep deep-link query strings or Blossom auth headers.
  Your secrets stay yours.
- Android tightens its network security config.

Loop on.

# 1.0.8 — Tighter loops, fewer weird edges

Big week on Divine.

We’ve been tightening the app up so it feels smoother, clearer, and more fun to use. Less friction. Less weirdness. More room for the good stuff.

## What’s new

- **Auto-advance is here** if you want to keep the loops rolling.
- **Captions moved into More Info** and your setting now sticks across videos.
- **Blocked accounts should stay out of your way** across comments, notifications, and search.

## What feels better

- **Watching on web, especially in fullscreen, should be a lot less flaky.**
- **Videos that used to get stuck on bad loading states should open more cleanly now.**
- **Loop counts and profile video counts should look a lot more trustworthy.**
- **Tapping names and profile links in comments works again.**
- **A bunch of sharp little bugs across feeds, profiles, navigation, and video playback got cleaned up too.**

## Help Us Test

If you’ve got a few minutes, we’d especially love help with:

- **Watching videos on web** from Home, Search, and Explore
- **Fullscreen swiping on web**
- **Turning captions on and off from More Info** and checking that the setting sticks
- **Trying auto-advance in the feed**
- **Blocking and unblocking someone**, then checking comments, notifications, and search
- **Opening profiles and checking video counts**, especially on older videos
- **Tapping creator names and profile links in comments**
- **Any video that used to get stuck on loading or error states**

Thanks for helping us tune this thing up. We’re building a better corner of the internet together.

**No slop. All human.**

Since 1.0.6, Divine has become faster, clearer, and much more ready for prime time.

We focused this release on making the app easier to trust, easier to navigate, and more fun to use. Feeds load faster. Playback is steadier. Account switching, sign-in, and invite flows are in better shape. Settings are cleaner. Reporting, moderation, legal, and support surfaces are easier to find. The camera, editor, and sharing flows also got a long list of quality fixes.

What stands out in 1.0.7:

- Faster, steadier watching: quicker startup, stronger feed caching, smoother scrolling, better playback recovery, fewer frozen or black frames, cached Explore/Profile refresh behavior, and safer handling for transcoded video fallbacks.
- Cleaner onboarding and account flows: improved invite-gated entry, better session-expired behavior, safer account switching, stronger login reliability, and clearer paths for review and support.
- Better settings and review-facing UX: Settings now split cleanly into dedicated sub-screens for Support Center, Content Preferences, Moderation Controls, Nostr Settings, and Legal.
- Stronger safety and support: more visible content reporting, moderation label improvements, trusted-moderator filters, flagged-content warnings, Zendesk support hardening, and clearer account deletion/data deletion flows.
- More capable creation tools: camera permission UX improvements, editor stability fixes, audio tools, Freesound integration, better gallery handling, clip/draft filtering by user, and a pile of rendering and crash fixes.
- Better social and messaging flows: message requests, DM reliability improvements, profile/feed refresh fixes, follower-count accuracy, easier sharing, and stronger notifications behavior.
- Platform and launch polish: branding cleanup, iOS/Android crash fixes, CI and hook hardening, Zapstore/release improvements, and a lot of under-the-hood work to make shipping safer.

The bigger theme is simple: less friction, more confidence, and more room to play.

Divine keeps pushing toward a human-made video app that feels alive, weird, and actually enjoyable to use. No slop. All human.

Since 1.0.5, Divine has become a much stronger playground for human creativity and connection.

We’ve made the app faster, steadier, and more expressive across the board. Feed loading is dramatically quicker. Playback is smoother. Search is sharper. Profiles, comments, badges, sharing, and notifications all got real attention. The camera, editor, and library also took a big step forward, with better audio tools, stronger draft handling, cleaner clip workflows, and fewer weird edge-case failures.

What’s new since 1.0.5:

- A faster, more stable feed: quicker home load, fewer black flashes and freezes, fewer phantom pauses, better subtitle support, cleaner overlays, safer pooled playback, and fixes for tricky Divine-hosted video URLs.
- Better discovery: a rebuilt home experience, a persistent For You mode, curated lists in feed logic, a new Categories tab in Explore, faster search behavior, and better hashtag reliability.
- Stronger identity and sign-in flows: multi-account support, better deep-link and email verification handling, session recovery improvements, external NIP-05 support, NIP-49 account import, and fixes so verified identity is shown more honestly.
- More capable creation tools: upgraded camera and video editor flows, custom audio rendering, audio editor support, countdown sound, auto lens switching, stronger clip deletion and drag interactions, better waveform feedback, improved gallery saving, and a redesigned drafts/clips library backed by more durable local storage.
- Better community features: real-time comments, profile comments tab, cross-device sync for likes and reposts, block-user support, clearer content warnings, stronger moderation lookups, and improved Human Made / AI badge handling.
- Better sharing and social actions: a cleaner unified share flow, restored download actions, better user search in sharing, smarter follow handling, and notification badge fixes.
- Platform and release improvements: macOS support, experimental Linux support, better Zapstore and release automation, improved Crashlytics symbol uploads, iOS crash fixes, Android background-work fixes, and build stability work.

The bigger theme is simple: more agency, less friction, and more room to play.

Divine is being shaped into a place for real people, real weirdness, and real creative ownership. No slop. No doom-scroll tax. Just a better space to make, share, and connect.

## What's New in 1.0.5 (Build 496 — Feb 23, 2026)

### Video Playback Fixes
- **Phantom pause eliminated**: Videos no longer freeze/stutter when swiping between them. Preloaded videos stay buffered (muted) instead of being paused, avoiding expensive rebuffer stalls on mobile hardware decoders (#1723)
- **No more dual audio**: Fixed bug where previous video's audio kept playing after swiping to next video (#1641)
- **Black flash removed**: Eliminated black flash between thumbnail placeholder and first video frame (#1642)
- **Disposed player crash fixed**: Prevented crash when Video widget accesses a player that was already disposed (#1643)
- **Pooled player for Home tab**: Home feed now uses shared pooled_video_player for consistent playback across all feeds (#1668)
- **Audio bleed fix**: No more hearing audio from videos that shouldn't be playing (#1683)
- **Correct video orientation**: Fixed fullscreen feed orientation handling (#1710)

### View Event Tracking (Kind 22236)
- **Decentralized analytics**: Publishes ephemeral Kind 22236 Nostr view events for creator analytics and recommendations
- **Granular traffic sources**: Tracks home, discovery (new/classic/foryou/popular), profile, share, search sources
- **Loop count tracking**: Includes loop count in view events for engagement metrics
- **Self-view filtering**: Skips publishing view events for creator's own videos (#1705)

### Upload & Publishing Safety
- **Local file path leak fixed**: Prevented local iOS device paths from being published in Nostr event imeta tags. Now constructs canonical Blossom URLs client-side per BUD-01 spec (#1722)
- **URL validation**: All video/image/audio URLs validated as HTTP(S) before publishing or persisting
- **Blossom server default fix**: Custom server toggle now correctly applies default when disabled (#1729)

### Relay & Network Improvements
- **Relay discovery**: Added relay.damus.io as 3rd indexer, skip empty cached results, clear cache on logout
- **Follower/following counts**: Direct indexer relay fallback for accurate counts (MAX-of-sources strategy)
- **Remote signer (NIP-46)**: Parallelized relay connections, NIP-46 compatible relay list, callback URL support
- **Android NIP-46 reconnection**: Reconnects relay WebSocket connections on app resume and divine:// callback after signer approval (#1713)
- **Blossom simplification**: Removed BlossmServerDiscoveryService, direct WebSocket via RelayBase

### Auth & Identity
- **Password-manager autofill hints** for login/signup (#1666)
- **Auth screen redesign** with divine_ui design system (#1645)
- **Silent key loss prevention**: Secure storage errors no longer silently lose keys (#1748)
- **Email verification deep link fix**: Calls verifyEmail directly from deep link listener (#1726)
- **Login screen scroll fix**: Users can no longer scroll past the sign-in button (#1743)

### Home & Feed
- **New home screen UI** with auto-refresh (#1650, #1745)
- **Reactive following list** in bloc (#1655)
- **Notification badge on all tabs**, not just profile (#1627)

### Search & Discovery
- **Hashtag search fix** (#1509)
- **Like and search flow fixes** (#1747)

### UI & Navigation
- **Pool player in profile grids** (#1669)
- **Safe area fix** for video actions on edge-to-edge Android (#1673)
- **Back navigation** for video editing routes (#1676)
- **Badge display fix**: Videos show correct badge like "fully-verified" (#1687)
- **Repost/Like preview mode**: Action buttons respect preview mode (#1725)

### Other Bug Fixes
- Fix metascreen video-preview broken (#1697)
- Fix unlike video and login with user/pwd (#1689)
- Fix bunker auth flow, auth pre-fetch cycle, relay stats (#1677)
- Fix NIP-98 spec compliance for URL, payload, and freshness (#1606)
- Fix repost count cache to prevent stale counts after unrepost (#1582)
- Diverse fixes in page and bloc (#1665)

---
